mapper.select: SELECT t.name AS tableName, CAST(ISNULL(ep.value, t.name) AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) AS tableComment FROM sys.tables t INNER JOIN sys.schemas s ON t.schema_id = s.schema_id LEFT JOIN sys.extended_properties ep ON ep.major_id = t.object_id AND ep.minor_id = 0 AND ep.name = 'MS_Description' WHERE t.is_ms_shipped = 0 ORDER BY s.name, t.name;
SELECT TABLE_NAME AS tableName, TABLE_COMMENT AS tableComment FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = DATABASE() and TABLE_NAME like 'mes3_%' ORDER BY TABLE_NAME;
